outcome: cesarean delivery due to arrest disorders
cesarean delivery due to nonreassuring fetal heart tracing
cohort: Multiparous women with >1 singleton pregnancy at ≥23 weeks' gestation at MedStar Washington Hospital Center from January 2009 to June 2018
finding: An interpregnancy interval of 60 months or greater was associated with increased odds of cesarean delivery due to arrest disorders compared to an interpregnancy interval of 18-59 months.
